title: Design scenario: stale reading, degraded battery
description: P2 fails. BMS reports SoH 92% but the reading is 47 min old; true capacity is degraded.

title: Fresh reading, healthy battery
description: Telemetry is fresh and accurate. Counterfactual challenge should add no cost.

title: Stale reading, healthy battery
description: Stale reading but the battery is actually fine. Tests the cost of caution.

title: Stale reading, mild degradation
description: True SoH is around the mild-degradation hypothesis.

title: Missing SoH reading
description: The BMS returns no SoH value.

title: Physically invalid SoH reading
description: The BMS reports SoH 137%, outside the physical range.

title: Diagnostic returns inconclusive
description: The capacity probe cannot complete. Inconclusive must not be treated as safe.

title: No safe plan exists
description: Low starting charge and degraded battery: every plan breaches the reserve or the deadline.

title: Backup pump fails on first start
description: B1 trips on its first start attempt; the verifier must detect it and replan.

title: Second fault: grid tie trips
description: After the first recovery, the grid tie trips.

title: Second fault: grid trip and B1 derate
description: After the first recovery, the grid trips and B1 is derated to 30% duty. No safe plan remains.
